root_cause: The current 1904 repository shows that critical-ui.js is running while app.js never reaches its handler registration. app.js itself is syntactically valid and registers before initialize(), so the failure is in ES-module loading/linking before app.js executes. The old architecture allowed a half-loaded planner and then guessed failure after two seconds.
strategy_change: Single atomic boot path: critical-ui.js owns app loading; index.html no longer separately starts app.js.
Start and Search both await the same module-load promise; there is no arbitrary timeout.
All 25 direct app.js imports use ?v=1905 to prevent direct dependency version mixing.
The service worker never substitutes stale cached code for current JS/CSS/JSON requests.
If module linking genuinely fails, the exact browser error is shown instead of the vague 'planner not fully loaded' message.

load_failure.error: De planner kon niet worden geladen: mock import link failure.
